featured_reviews.name: shruti kamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Timezone at R City Mall, and it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience! The gaming zone at Timezone is vibrant, well-maintained, and packed with a wide variety of games suitable for all age groups.

From arcade classics to modern interactive games, there’s something for everyone. We explored multiple games including racing simulators, basketball shootouts, air hockey, and a few skill-based arcade challenges. The machines were all in great condition, and the staff was helpful whenever needed, which made the overall experience smooth and enjoyable.

However, the highlight of our visit was definitely the bowling game! It was incredibly engaging and well-organized. What made it even more exciting was that we got 20 rounds with 10 balls per person, which gave us plenty of time to enjoy, compete, and improve our game. The setup was excellent, and the scoring system was easy to follow, making it fun even for beginners.

The atmosphere was lively, with great lighting and energetic vibes, making it a perfect place to unwind with friends or family. We genuinely had a great time laughing, competing, and just enjoying the moment.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and the bowling game truly made our visit special. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun outing in Ghatkopar

✨ Vibrant Ambience: Super lively and spacious enough to handle a corporate crowd without feeling cramped. 🌈

🎮 Endless Entertainment: From bowling to the latest arcade games, boredom stands no chance here! 🎳🎯

Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a seamless and high-energy corporate event! 🔥

What I appreciate most is the environment. The café has a great gaming vibe—clean, organized, and designed perfectly for gamers. The seating is comfortable, the lighting is just right, and there’s minimal disturbance, which helps you stay fully focused on the game. The staff is friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist if there’s any technical issue. They ensure everything runs smoothly, which makes the overall experience stress-free. Pricing is reasonable for the quality of service and equipment they offer.

Whether you’re a casual gamer or someone serious about competitive gaming, Consol PC Gaming Café is an excellent choice. I always leave satisfied and look forward to my next gaming session here. Highly recommended for anyone who loves PC gaming.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the recent experience at this gaming café. The issue isn’t just about the pricing—it’s about honesty, consistency, and how you treat your customers.

On 31st May, we were charged ₹100 for a 3-hour session (10 PM to 1 AM), which clearly means the rate was ₹33/hr or a flat discount.

Again, on 4th July, we were charged ₹120 for 3 hours, which is ₹40/hr. Still under the so-called “₹80/hr” rate.

But on 18th July, the staff suddenly claimed that they’ve been charging ₹80/hr for the past 2 years and said happy hours have been discontinued which is a clear contradiction to our previous two visits.

We even showed them screenshots of payments from previous visits as proof, but instead of acknowledging the discrepancy, they bluntly denied ever charging less. The attitude was dismissive and unprofessional, as if we were trying to lie about our own payments.

To make matters worse, the place is equipped with CCTV cameras covering every corner. They could have easily verified our previous visits and payment timings, but they chose to ignore all evidence and continue arguing rather than resolve the issue professionally.

Let me be clear it’s not about ₹80 vs ₹50 per hour. When you have a group of 10 players, these inconsistent rates add up to a big difference. And the worst part is the lack of transparency and denial despite proof.

If this is how you treat your regular customers, I don't see a reason to return or recommend this place. It’s time you fix your communication, standardize your pricing, and treat your paying customers with basic respect.

featured_reviews.name: Mohit Meswani
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Birthday Celebration We’ll Remember for Years ❤️

We celebrated our kid’s 5th birthday at Play N Learn (Phoenix Marketcity Mumbai) on 17-May, and it genuinely turned out to be one of the most fun, seamless & memorable celebrations for both kids and parents alike ❤️

From the planning stage to the final goodbye, the entire team made the experience feel effortless. A huge shoutout to Sanjana, the party manager, along with Pranjali, Pramila & the entire party crew for being incredibly warm, patient, energetic & hands-on throughout. The kids had an absolute blast, and everything was managed so smoothly that we as parents could actually relax and enjoy the celebration too.

A very special mention to Chef Kamalaker and the F&B team — the food was honestly outstanding. Every single item served was fresh, super tasty & surprisingly good for a kids’ party venue. Our guests kept going back for seconds and constantly complimented the food through the evening!

What truly stood out though was the warmth & hospitality of the entire staff. Everyone was smiling, helpful, attentive & genuinely invested in making the day special for our kid and all our guests. It never felt transactional — it felt like a team that truly enjoys creating happy memories for families.

Thank you once again to the entire Play N Learn Phoenix Marketcity Mumbai team for giving us such a joyful, stress-free & beautiful celebration. We’ll genuinely look back at this birthday with the biggest smiles ✨

featured_reviews.name: CA Dhairya Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
When we first saw the setup at the entrance, we didn’t expect much—it looked like a simple, standard arrangement. There are many such mystery rooms in the market that feel very basic and even childish. But once we got started, this experience turned out to be amazing and completely unexpected!

The level of mystery, suspense, and thrill was incredible. It’s a fantastic place to hang out with a group of friends and have an exciting time.e
Especially the mystery and horror ones, were absolutely mind-blowing.

The entire team, including the live actors inside the rooms, did an exceptional job. The setup is absolutely mind-blowing, and nothing prepares you for what’s coming next. It’s intense, thrilling, and genuinely scary—perfect for an unforgettable adventure. This is a one-of-a-kind experience that I’d 110% recommend to anyone looking for something unique and exciting!

We had an amazing time and can’t wait to try out all the levels available. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a thrilling and engaging experience!

featured_reviews.name: fahila sarang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mystery Rooms – 2.5/5
The ring
Overall, it was okay, but a bit disappointing.
There was no proper video introduction, so the story wasn’t clear. The room was too dark and had no proper directions, which made it confusing.
The setup was actually very good, but the experience didn’t match up. The walkie-talkie voice was annoying and not helpful. Some clues seemed already disturbed, and the rooms weren’t labeled properly.
The live actor was a good part of the experience.
But for ₹1000 per person, it didn’t feel worth it.

They should add a video experience and give souvenir to carry. But nothing.  In fact we could not even click a picture by the end near the mystery room. They asked us to take it in a lock up next to the reception. It was very underwhelming

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Parab
featured_reviews.review_text: Quite a mysterious game. There are a total of 4 mystery games to be played here and we participated in the Con for Kohinoor game and it was quite thrilling and difficult too. There were a lot of puzzles and hurdles which were really not easy to crack. One needs to be very sharp to crack these puzzles. We were a team of 7 and still could not complete the task to get a Kohinoor diamond and escape out of the room. It was really fun and I would definitely like to go back and participate in other games
